svg.title: Requested outreach drafts with manual Gmail sending
svg.desc: Telegram messages enter a saved queue. LangGraph answers questions and uses reading tools. An explicit email request and the owner's Create draft action enter drafting. Known recipients go directly to writing preparation without prospect discovery or fit scoring. Finding new contacts follows research, qualification and address selection. Both paths retain relationship checks, writing, review and duplicate protection. The owner reviews, edits and sends in Gmail. SQLite or one Supabase PostgreSQL database holds saved state.
